create_config_get_config: create a training configuration by calling get_config to get learning rate, dataset paths, and model settings
create_config_get_light_gnn_model_config: create a LightGNN model configuration by calling get_light_gnn_model_config to get layer sizes and dropout parameters
build_config_training: build a Neural LNS training config with get_config including train/valid datasets, decay steps, and grad clip norm
build_config_lightgnn: build a LightGNN model config with get_light_gnn_model_config specifying 2 layers, hidden sizes [64,64], and dropout 0.1
review_config_get_config: review the get_config function that returns ml_collections.ConfigDict with training hyperparameters and dataset paths
